STEP 1 - Vessel type: The food sits on a flat white square plate with a rim band and a flat centre, no inner wall visible. Flat square plate.

STEP 2 - Vessel size:
a) Type: square plates are 20-30 cm. The plate looks medium-large relative to the food, so I estimate about 25 cm.
b) Reference: the olives are about 2.2 cm. The pizza slices span roughly 4-5 olive lengths in width... more usefully, the pizza slice is roughly 11 cm long and the plate's visible width is about 2.3 slice lengths, giving about 25 cm. Both cues agree.
Final width: 25 cm square, area = 625 cm².

STEP 3 - Items:
- Pizza: two rectangular slices (one cut piece on top, one below), visible footprint about 2 slices x roughly 11 x 6 cm. Thin flatbread style, so count as about 2 bread-slice equivalents of 30 g each plus cheese and sauce topping. Estimate pizza total ~150 g (crust ~60 g, cheese and toppings ~90 g).
- Grilled chicken: a pile of diced pieces covering roughly 80 cm² at about 1 cm average thickness (two pieces stacked at the thickest point, half-mound average). Volume ~50 ml, density 1.0, so ~70 g.
- Mixed salad greens (raw leafy greens with carrot and some cucumber): footprint about 120 cm², average thickness about 3 cm (mound), volume ~ 360 ml x 0.15 density ≈ 55 g. Round up with dressing to ~70 g.
- Kalamata-style olives: count about 14 visible, plus about 6 hidden, so 20 olives x 4 g = 80 g.
- Crispy tortilla or cracker-like wedge on the top right: about 15 g.

STEP 4 - Hidden food: the salad and chicken sit on the plate surface with no substantial base layer, so no additional hidden items beyond what is counted.

STEP 5 - kcal per 100 g (as served):
- Pizza (flatbread with cheese and meat): ~260 kcal/100 g, 150 g → 390 kcal
- Grilled chicken: ~165 kcal/100 g, 70 g → 116 kcal
- Mixed salad with dressing: ~40 kcal/100 g, 70 g → 28 kcal
- Olives: ~115 kcal/100 g, 80 g → 92 kcal
- Crisp wedge: ~450 kcal/100 g, 15 g → 68 kcal

Total roughly 300 g of food, about 690 kcal.
